title: Calcitonin Measurement - Reasons for false positive results
summary: Reasons for false positive calcitonin values are multifactorial. The reasons should be identified.

interventions.name: The aim of the present study is to identify possible reasons for increased calcitonin levels. Patients with increased calcitonin levels will be retrospectively investigated.
